post.description:
Creates the submitted credit transfers.

If a submitted reference matches an existing credit transfer that has not reached the bank yet — one shown in the credit transfer list as Draft, Cancelled, Rejected by signatory or Rejected by depositary — that credit transfer is updated with the submitted data instead of being rejected as a duplicate, and its ID is returned. Updating is only possible for credit transfers you are permitted to access. A reference matching a credit transfer in any other status is rejected as a duplicate, as is a reference submitted together with batching parameters. A credit transfer submitted without a reference always creates a new one.
